info.title: API.SH: Zara
info.description: The Zara API from API.SH: public Zara data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
A product's colours with every size's current online stock in the chosen market (in stock, low on stock, out of stock, coming soon), its SKU, demand level and price. Zara does not publish per-store stock to logged-out visitors.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zara-availability

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Product link.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Store country (default from the link, else US).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: FAUX LEATHER JACKET
example.note: online stock of the selected market; Zara does not publish per-store stock to logged-out visitors

get.description:
A Zara store's category menu by section (woman, man, kids, home, beauty...): each category's id (the id /zara/v1/category takes), name, level, link, whether it lists products, and its subcategories.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zara-categories

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Store country (default US).

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Only this section (WOMAN, MAN, KIDS, ZARA HOME, BEAUTY...).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: en (default) or local.

parameters.name: include_hidden
parameters.description: true keeps entries hidden from the menu.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The products of a Zara category (as listed on the category page, in its order) in one of 18 markets. Each product: id, reference, name, section, family, price and old price (in the market's currency), availability, every colour with its own price, stock and images, link, main image and `raw`. Give the category's `id` (the v1 number in its link) or its link. 24 per page; `total` is set on the category's last page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zara-category

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The category's id: the `v1` number in its link (zara.com/us/en/woman-dresses-l1066.html?v1=2420895). Give this or `url`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A zara.com category link (…-l<number>.html, with or without `?v1=`); its market sets `country` unless given.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market (default US).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Zara product by its 8-digit reference (or link) in one market: id, reference, name, section, family, price and old price, availability, every colour with its own price, stock, reference and images, all images, link and `raw`. 404 when the product is not sold in that market.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zara-product

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: The product's 8-digit reference (in its link after `-p`), e.g. `01887410`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A zara.com product link (…-p<8 digits>.html); its market is used unless `country` is given.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market: US (default), GB, CA, AU, IN, AE, SA, ES, DE, FR, IT, NL, PT, PL, TR, MX, BR, JP.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: `en` (default) or `local`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products on Zara for keywords in one of 18 markets, with the site's section, price sort and facet filters. Each product: id, reference, name, section, family, price and old price (in the market's currency), availability, every colour with its own price, stock and images, link, main image and `raw`. `facets` lists the colour, size and category filters with counts; pass a facet's `filter` value back as `filter`. 24 per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zara-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords, e.g. `dress`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market: US (default), GB, CA, AU, IN, AE, SA, ES, DE, FR, IT, NL, PT, PL, TR, MX, BR, JP.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: `en` (default) for English names, or `local` for the market's own language.

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: WOMAN, MAN, KID or HOME.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Facet filters from the response's `facets[].values[].filter`, comma-separated (up to 8), e.g. `color_facet:black`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (up to 40). Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Zara stores near a point, nearest first: address, coordinates, distance, phones, opening hours for the coming days, sections (woman, man, kids), click-and-collect and other services.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zara-stores

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Store country site to ask (default US).

parameters.name: pickup_only
parameters.description: true lists only stores with pickup.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
